messages:
mike (sales): FYI — FinServ prospect asking for 7-year audit log retention + BYOK (customer-managed keys). Wants searchable audit history for compliance investigators. Asking if we can do this in-contract.
elaine (product): Quick Qs: are they asking full-event-level search for 7 years or just exportable snapshots?
mike (sales): They said "searchable" but also mentioned legal e-discovery. Probably need event-level search for last 90 days, exports for older.
nana (solutions): @mike (sales) typo — that's ana (solutions).
nana (solutions): Suggestion: tiered model — 90d hot search index, 6.9y cold archive (WORM blobs). We can surface a time-limited search UI that hits the index and provide export tools for cold. :thinking:
dave (eng-sre): Tech note: keeping 7 years of event-level indexable data increases index cost ~x8. Cold archive is cheap but search latency and restore cost are high. We can offer sampled indexing (e.g., event metadata in index, full payload in blob).
sara (security): SOC2/ISO angle: retention + BYOK is doable, but we need key escrow/rotation policy spelled out. If keys are fully customer-managed (no escrow), we must document data-recovery constraints in contract. Also legal hold: how will holds be applied across cold archives?
ben (legal): We need explicit contract language for: retention period, legal-hold overrides, key-loss scenarios, and evidence export format. Also define SLAs for export time after request (e.g., 72h for cold).
maria (cs): Customer flagged they'd pay for dedicated vault + reserved capacity. They're worried about costs and auditability. Can we create a pricing tier?
elaine (product): Draft acceptance criteria proposal (first pass):
```
- Hot search: event-level, full-text, 90 days, 99th pctile query latency <= 300ms
- Cold archive: 7 years retained immutable blobs, searchable via export request
- BYOK: customer-supplied KMS with rotation policy; if keys lost, customer acknowledges potential data unrecoverability
- Legal hold: ability to lock selected tenant data from deletion across tiers
- Export SLA: synchronous exports for <=90d, async for >90d with max 72h turnaround
- Cost model: dedicated capacity + per-GB cold storage + export egress fee
```
nana (solutions): Implementation notes: need export-playbook, background restore workers, and pre-signed export manifests for auditors. Also, indexing metadata fields to minimize index size (user id, action, timestamp, objid, outcome).
dave (eng-sre): Rough implementation effort: index redesign + export pipeline + retention lifecycle = 4 sprints (8 engineers) + 2 sprints for BYOK integration and keying ops. We should also plan a pilot with one tenant before GA.
sara (security): For BYOK, add requirement for KMS access audit logs (customer-side) and we must bind our audit logs to a customer key so exported evidence remains verifiable. Need HSM/KMS cert checks.
ben (legal): For contract negotiation with FinServ, recommend conservative defaults: export SLA 72h, escrow option for keys (optional charged service), and indemnities limited for data-loss if keys are customer-managed.
maria (cs): Customer signals: prefer no escrow but wants a runbook that proves export reliability. They'd sign if export SLAs and cost estimates are clear.
elaine (product): Proposal: create a scoped pilot doc + acceptance checklist for pilots. Pilot scope: 6 months retention hot index, cold archive retention 2 years (pilot), BYOK integration in dev, two export rehearsals. Success metrics: export correctness, export time <= 72h, no security infra issues.
mike (sales): I'll propose pilot and pricing. Can we get an internal estimate and a one-page pilot SOW?
dave (eng-sre): Will produce estimate today for infra + eng effort.
ben (legal): I'll draft minimal contract clauses for pilot.
sara (security): I'll add checklist for key verification, IAM mapping, and audit trail requirements.
elaine (product): Next steps: 1) dave sends infra estimate by EOD 2) ben drafts pilot contract 3) ana drafts pilot runbook + export playbook 4) mike updates customer and confirms pilot sign-off.
maria (cs): +1. I'll coordinate kickoff call once we have SOW. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled export-runner job v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-21T14:12:00Z :rocket:
elaine (product): tagging this as action items in the roadmap doc and linking to the Compliance Epic. We'll iterate acceptance criteria after pilot results.
mike (sales): Thanks team — I'll update customer tomorrow and loop in FinServ compliance contact for a kickoff.
ben (legal): FYI — will need to add a clause about retention under regulatory request; will circulate draft by EOD.
nana (solutions): small nit: should we surface retention toggles in the Console UI for tenant admins (opt-in for paid tier)?
elaine (product): Yes, make UX opt-in behind an enterprise toggle with audit trail. Add to backlog.
dave (eng-sre): one more technical: implement per-tenant retention metadata to avoid cross-tenant sweep issues.
sara (security): also require approval flow for legal holds (2 approvers recommended).
elaine (product): Great — closing notes: pilot-doc -> backlog tasks -> pilot SOW. I'll create the pilot issue and tag everyone. Thanks.
